desc: Ideation: derive the forced bottom-up DP and identify the `c == 2 ⇒ s must equal K` pitfall.

Write the complete solution: fast I/O, `K==1`/`NK==1` shortcuts, CSR adjacency build, iterative BFS (`par[]`, `order[]`), reverse-order DP with `ssum[]`/`ccnt[]` and the corrected recurrence, final root check, print `Yes`/`No`.

Validation: samples traced (1 → Yes, 2 → No), `c==2 && s<K` rejection, root-cannot-extend rejection, `c>2` rejection, `K==1`/`NK==1` shortcuts, and O(NK) iterative implementation confirms performance at 2·10⁵ vertices.
